name: git-forensics-skill
description: Your git log already knows where the bugs are: hotspots, hidden coupling and bus factor from history alone.

plugins.name: git-forensics-skill
plugins.description: Five skills and two agents that rank fragile files by churn and complexity, reveal files that change together without referencing each other, report bus factor and knowledge at risk, brief a newcomer on the state of a codebase and run a disciplined git bisect.
